name: Facewall
lore: The faces come further out the longer you look at it. None of them are finished and all of them are the same one.
prompt: Slab of cave wall walking on two stone stubs, with human faces pushing out of the rock from inside it, all of them smiling, some fully formed and some only a brow or a mouth emerging, the stone stretched thin over them
